'''Paddewwa Teleport''' is a spell from the [[Ancient Magicks|Ancient spellbook]] that [[teleport]]s the caster to the [[Edgeville Dungeon]]. As with all [[Ancient Magicks]] spells, the quest [[Desert Treasure I]] must be completed to cast this spell.

Teleporting to Paddewwa is a requirement for the [[Hard Varrock Diary]].
